meta.title: Buyer applies AI Smart Grouping to the PR table

plan.title: Apply AI Smart Grouping to PR Table

steps.note: Open the Purchase Requisitions page where the PR table and Smart Grouping control are available.

args.goal: On the Purchase Requisitions page, click Smart Grouping, select a recommended prompt such as Group by product category, click the blue send icon, wait for the Procol AI response showing grouping logic and applied conditions, click Apply Grouping, and stop with the PR table showing the new Smart Groups.

steps.note: Perform the Smart Grouping interaction and confirm the AI response and applied grouping on the buyer's screen.
Assert that the PR table visibly shows Smart Groups after applying the AI grouping.
